step: the machine connects; the app watches the overview
the app opens a terminal on the pane: it gets the screen

pty %1.cmd: tmux bind-key -T inyon-view WheelUpPane if-shell -F '#{||:#{pane_in_mode},#{mouse_any_flag}}' 'send-keys -M' 'copy-mode -e'; tmux bind-key -T inyon-view MouseDown1Pane 'select-pane -t = ; send-keys -M'; tmux bind-key -T inyon-view MouseDrag1Pane if-shell -F '#{||:#{pane_in_mode},#{mouse_any_flag}}' 'send-keys -M' 'copy-mode -M'; exec tmux -u new-session -s 'inyon-view-<random>' -n inyon-tmp \; link-window -s '@1' -t 'inyon-view-<random>:' \; kill-window -t 'inyon-view-<random>:inyon-tmp' \; set-option -t 'inyon-view-<random>' status off \; set-option -t 'inyon-view-<random>' key-table inyon-view \; set-option -t 'inyon-view-<random>' prefix None \; set-option -t 'inyon-view-<random>' prefix2 None \; set-option -t 'inyon-view-<random>' destroy-unattached on \; select-pane -t '%1'
